title: Dual Ended Precision Blush Brush
descriptionHtml:
✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: A dual-ended precision blush brush that gives you maximum color control and perfect placement when applying cream and powder formulas.

Brush Formulation: All Formulas

Brush Coverage: Buildable

Bristle Type: Synthetic

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance. It is also cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: This custom-created brush is petite and precise, made for perfect placement and a diffused glow every time your blush. The smaller, tapered silhouette makes
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
Patrick’s Signature Application:
-For a dimensional, glossy look and ultimate color payoff, apply the powder formula with the fluffy end, followed by the cream formula with the dense end.

Cream Application:
-For a sheer and dewy glow, use the dense side of the brush to dab the cream formula onto the apples of the cheeks.

Powder Application:
-For an airbrushed effect, swirl the fluffy end of the brush into your compact and evenly distribute the formula into bristles.
-Sweep across the apples of the cheeks to finish.
